summary: Iter 132 Brevo subscription sync — backend + mocked + frontend tests all green. Mocked unit test passes (only missing attributes created, no listIds, multi-org pick to nearest non-expired expiry, daily idempotent). Live backend endpoints verified against the preview URL with real SA/QA creds: overview returns configured=false and the full attributes dict; non-SA gets 403; POST resync for QA org returns ok=false with error 'Brevo non configurato (BREVO_API_KEY)' and persists a row in saas_brevo_sync (status=error, attrs CRM_STATO=Trial & CRM_ORG_ID=org_qa_eventi, recipients only qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it); unknown org -> 404; POST sync-all {only_failed:true} returns totals; regression saas/me OK; cron saas-trial-tick without auth -> 401; run_expiry_notices no longer exists in backend/subscriptions.py and run_trial_notices wires hooks['daily']. Frontend SA /marketing/brevo?tab=abbonamenti renders subscription-sync-panel with sub-sync-not-configured, sub-sync-status ('Non configurato'), sub-sync-count, sub-sync-errors, sub-sync-last, 13 rows (sub-sync-row-{org_id}) with sub-sync-one-* buttons; sub-sync-failed click produces a toast with the error count ('Sincronizzate 0/1 · Brevo non configurato (BREVO_API_KEY)'); 390px mobile shows no horizontal overflow. Previous feature regression /profilo?tab=abbonamento for QA renders sub-status and sub-activate. Cleaned up db.saas_brevo_sync (13 docs removed).
critical_code_review_comments: brevo_subscriptions.sync_org stores the hash only on success (correct — forces retry). Good.
overview counts synced_ok/errors by iterating rows already loaded (limit 1000). If org count grows beyond that, totals could drift; low priority.
